lessons_used: Reordering sign-in after adoption (sign_in, reorder) was helpful (+7.0%), though the measured lift was less than predicted (+15.0%).
Streamlining path selection copy (choose_path, copy) significantly hurt performance (-4.7%), contrary to the predicted +5.0% gain.
Grid selection layouts (adoption, layout) showed no clear effect.
Background notifications upon completion (finish, notification) showed no clear effect.
Estimated wait times and desktop alerts (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently too optimistic across all tested changes.

lessons_next: Reordering sign-in after adoption (sign_in, reorder) was helpful (+7.0% in round 1), though a subsequent test showed no clear effect.
Streamlining path selection copy (choose_path, copy) significantly hurt performance (-4.7%).
Copy updates on completion (finish, copy) and new interactive flows (choose_path, new_flow) showed no clear effect.
Grid selection layouts (adoption, layout) and background notifications (finish, notification) showed no clear effect.
Estimated wait times, alerts, and waiting hints (home, wait_info / hint) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently too optimistic across all tested changes.
